verified.subject: Address and floor count
verified.evidence: Brochure pages 26 and 3 identify Plot 20, Neopolis Layout, Kokapet, Hyderabad and advertise 52 storeys.

verified.subject: Wings and floor plates
verified.evidence: Pages 7 and 15 show a connected T-shaped tower, transverse A wing of seven designs and B wing of six. The typical arrangement is specifically labelled floors 17–20 and 22–26. Floor 12 replaces the A7 bay with a refuge area.

verified.subject: Layout facts
verified.evidence: Pages 17–23 provide the 13 plan sheets, bedroom/study configuration, design code and distinct TOTAL SBA and TOTAL CARPET AREA. See brochure-manifest.json. Page 18 identifies A3 at 2,790 and 1,873 square feet respectively. Brochure plans govern the demo where overview ranges differ.

verified.subject: Façade vocabulary
verified.evidence: Artist impressions on pages 2, 3, 12 and 23 show recessed windows, tall limestone frames, bands of terracotta, a ventilated podium, glazed balconies and projecting crown cornices.

verified.subject: Outdoor amenities
verified.evidence: Page 7 identifies entry, driveway, drop-off, water feature, paths, event lawn, clubhouse access, padel, tennis, pickleball, practice basketball and pet park. Page 9 depicts the eco deck, page 11 the landscaped sky deck and page 12 the clubhouse artist impression with roof pool.

verified.subject: Geographic evidence
verified.evidence: HMDA Plot 20 WGS84 coordinate table, brochure parcel/wing plan, clipped OpenStreetMap roads/buildings/lakes, March 2025 Sentinel imagery and gridded elevation. Kokapet Lake, Osman Sagar and Outer Ring Road are named in the OSM extract.

illustrative.subject: Exterior and masterplan
illustrative.basis: Hand traces of pages 7, 9, 11 and 15. The published Plot 20 vertices set the site outline. The façade profile uses nominal 15 m podium, open Eco level, 3.05 m module, and stepped crowns. The taller conceptual wing reaches the 52-storey silhouette described on page 3; per-wing band counts and elevations are illustrative. Floor 12 has an A7 refuge opening. Seven club levels and the rooftop pool follow pages 3 and 12. Club interiors are unlocated studies; room placement and tower setting-out remain indicative.

illustrative.subject: A3 furnished apartment
illustrative.basis: Plan trace from brochure page 18. Materials, ceiling heights, furniture, fixtures, lighting and clearance approximations are design interpretation. Room stills support non-WebGL browsers.

illustrative.subject: Development placement
illustrative.basis: The source-plan trace is registered to HMDA Plot 20 with a rigid four-corner fit (A, P, O, B) and 1.033 m RMS corner residual. Origin 17.402192529 N, 78.312086932 E. The lawn boundary follows the 16 published vertices. Model axes and residuals appear in scene-map.json. Tower setting-out, floor height, eye position and actual balcony views remain approximate.

illustrative.subject: Neighborhood representation
illustrative.basis: Community-mapped features clipped to the documented WGS84 bounding box. Heights are estimated from footprint area. Single line roads use representative widths and map layer values. Roadside planting is representative. Terrain comes from the 40 m sampled grid with a locally leveled building pad. Imagery records land cover in March 2025.

illustrative.subject: Geographic lighting presets
illustrative.basis: Representative licensed HDR reflections and four lighting simulations use the registered axes, latitude and longitude on an equinox day. A construction daylight or verified outlook study is unavailable.

illustrative.subject: Residence collection
illustrative.basis: Each of the remaining twelve apartments has an independent metric trace and model, a room-by-room navigation graph, its own stills and an editable Blender master. Furniture, wall elevations, finishes and glazing are illustrative.
